title: Every Sneeze Swaps You With the Person Next to You… Even the MAYOR 🤧
description:
In this town, when you SNEEZE, you swap places with whoever's standing closest! Dad ends up in Mr Gomez's tomatoes, Mrs Patel's class gets a nine-year-old teacher… and nobody EVER listens to our hero. Until the new Hilltop Bridge starts to wobble, the mayor freezes, and one tickly feather changes everything. 🤧🌉

A short, kid-friendly story about speaking up, helping out, and Dad's very useful garden hose.
